bio: THE CELIBATE RIFLES WERE SYDNEY PUNK ROCK LIFERS — LOUD, SMART, POLITICAL, FUNNY AND NEVER INTERESTED IN PLAYING IT SAFE. BUILT ON RIPPING GUITARS, SHARP LYRICS AND A FIERCE LIVE REPUTATION, THEY SPENT DECADES MAKING TOUGH, HOOKY AUSTRALIAN ROCK WITH BRAINS AND BITE. CULT HEROES, PUB-ROCK SURVIVORS AND STILL A SERIOUSLY GREAT BAND TO DISCOVER.
